notes.notes:
A major update “Yin Yang Girl” has been implemented.
Please enjoy the new version of ``Momo no Hana wa Senketsu ni Shiru'' brought to life by voice actors.

[Important] Regarding save data migration
In many scenes, you can use the save data while the story is in progress without any problems, but in some scenes the story may not be able to be loaded properly because the story has been changed.
In that case, we apologize for the inconvenience, but please start from another save data or start from the beginning.
System data is still available in this case.

1. Added text retakes and event CG to traditional stories
2. The story is completed by releasing chapters 7 and 12.
3. Powered up and newly recorded “Rei no Shou”
Four. Significant remake of standing pictures and addition of a large amount of new event CG
Five. Compatible with portable gaming PC "Steam Deck"
6. Addition of voices by gorgeous voice actors to add color to the sad story
7. Newly written theme song "Yin Yang Girl" by Kokuyo, who was in charge of the opening song.

The above-mentioned large-scale update will be a "paid grade" volume that far exceeds the main story of "Peach Blossoms Are Dyed with Fresh Blood" which is on sale.
